blind.description: A square cracked grey stone floor plinth supporting a stylized bronze/brass dragon or gargoyle head. The dragon head has horns, open jaws, and a cylindrical nozzle inside the mouth facing forward. The stone in front of the mouth has dark scorch marks. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with no floating or broken elements.
blind.from_above: A square grey flagstone with a bronze horned dragon head facing downward, flanked by dark soot or burn staining on the stone surface.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.5 to 2 feet tall (about one-quarter to one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the square stone base.
